result.hard_numeric_fact_text: FACT: Ind-Ra revised outlook on bank loans/FD to Positive from Stable, ratings affirmed IND AA/IND A1+ (filed 20 Oct 2026). CALCULATION (dossier): Q1 FY27 revenue +5.4% YoY, EBITDA +41.5%, PAT +106%, EBITDA margin 9.7%.

bear.assumptions: ASSUMPTION: Heubach integration slips, margin stuck ~10%, PAT ~Rs160 cr, multiple compresses from 118x TTM to 28x

base.assumptions: ASSUMPTION: EBITDA margin recovers to ~12-13% on synergies, PAT ~Rs235 cr FY28, 30x

bull.assumptions: ASSUMPTION: Synergies fully delivered, margin ~15%, PAT ~Rs330 cr, 32x

extreme_bull.assumptions: ASSUMPTION: Pigment up-cycle plus deleveraging, PAT ~Rs430 cr, 35x

risk.order_firmness: unknown; no order book disclosed in extracted filings

result.thesis: Pigment maker digesting the Heubach acquisition: portfolio pruning (VP4 Frankfurt sold to Celanese) and backward integration (Clariant Muttenz aluminium-dye plant, closing ~4 Jan 2027). Q1 FY27 profit doubled but off a tiny base; revenue only +5.4% and margin 9.7%. Ind-Ra outlook to Positive is a balance-sheet fact, not a demand or pricing signal. At 118x TTM P/E the price already assumes synergy delivery. No demand shock, supply constraint or pricing evidence in the filings.
chain_missing_links: Demand inflection (revenue +5.4% YoY; FY +194% is acquisition consolidation)
Supply constraint and pricing power: no evidence
result.demand_signal: unknown; Q1 FY27 revenue +5.4% YoY (CALCULATION). Peer industry median revenue +25.2% in dossier scan, so the company lags its peer set.
result.capacity_catalyst: Muttenz (Switzerland) aluminium-dye plant acquisition from Clariant, completion expected ~4 Jan 2027: converts a supply arrangement into ownership; no capacity or revenue figure disclosed (FACT/MANAGEMENT CLAIM). VP4 Frankfurt divested (Diketene tolling), small captive use.
result.cfo_to_pat: Dossier 15.43 for latest FY, not meaningful on a near-zero PAT base (ROE 0.7%); class healthy per dossier; true cash conversion unknown
result.debt: ND/EBITDA 1.80, interest cover 6.3, dilution 0.1% (CALCULATION). Ind-Ra IND AA/Positive (FACT).
result.valuation: Mcap Rs8,467 cr, TTM P/E 118.3, EV/EBITDA 14.7, PEG 1.13 (CALCULATION). Dossier conflict: earnings block says turnaround True while discovery block says turnaround False; one-off share of EBITDA 13.7%. Q1 results text not in the extracted filings, so one-offs could not be verified.

plausible.2x: NO: needs EPS ~Rs70+ at 30x, i.e. PAT ~Rs550 cr vs ~Rs72 cr TTM
plausible.3x: NO: not supported by any evidence in hand

kill_conditions: Q2 FY27 EBITDA margin below 9% or revenue growth below 5% YoY
ND/EBITDA above 2.5x or Ind-Ra outlook reverted to Stable
Muttenz closing delayed past Q1 CY2027 or cost exceeds disclosed budget
One-offs above 20% of EBITDA in a second consecutive quarter
result.biggest_risk: Paying 118x trailing earnings for a turnaround whose revenue growth is 5% while peers grow 25%; acquisition integration and leverage.
result.next_datapoint: Q2 FY27 results: revenue growth vs 5.4%, EBITDA margin vs 9.7%, one-off share, CFO
